name: vscode-secondary-terminal
description: Dedicated Side Bar Terminal with multiple tabs, interactive shell, cursor customization, and AI Agent execution monitoring.

secondaryTerminal.cursorBlink.description: Optional Side Terminal override. When unset, follows the corresponding integrated terminal setting. Controls whether the terminal cursor blinks.

secondaryTerminal.cursorStyle.description: Optional Side Terminal override. When unset, follows the corresponding integrated terminal setting. Controls the cursor style in the side terminal.

secondaryTerminal.fontSize.description: Optional Side Terminal override. When unset, follows the corresponding integrated terminal setting. Controls the font size in pixels in the side terminal.

secondaryTerminal.fontFamily.description: Optional Side Terminal override. When unset, follows the corresponding integrated terminal setting. Controls the font family in the side terminal.

secondaryTerminal.lineHeight.description: Optional Side Terminal override. When unset, follows the corresponding integrated terminal setting. Controls the line height relative to font size in the side terminal.

secondaryTerminal.scrollback.description: Optional Side Terminal override. When unset, follows the corresponding integrated terminal setting. Controls the maximum number of lines kept in scrollback history.

secondaryTerminal.mirrorAgentTerminals.description: Monitor recognized AI agent terminals as read-only tabs. Requires VS Code 1.93+ and shell integration; interactive input stays in the source terminal.

scripts.package: npm run package-ext && npm run package-webview
scripts.compile-tests: node -e "require('fs').rmSync('out', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc -p . --outDir out
scripts.pretest: npm run compile-tests && npm run compile

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Side Terminal starts interactive shells in the workspace and requires Workspace Trust.

virtualWorkspaces.description: Native PTY sessions require access to a filesystem workspace.
